title: Cancel auto-renew: explained, handed off
opening: I want to cancel my Comfort Club membership.
callerBrief: You are Sofia Brown, phone 512-547-7902, at 3307 Lakeshore Blvd, Pflugerville. You are a standard Comfort Club member and you want to cancel it. Give your name and phone when asked. When told the plan is annual and what that means for a refund, say: that's fine, just make sure it doesn't renew. Accept that someone will turn off auto-renew. Then say that is all. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: Auto-renewal can be cancelled at any time before the renewal date, 2027-07-11
Annual plans are non-refundable once a tune-up has been performed in the current term
Staff will turn off auto-renew; the agent does not say it is already off

dbChange.detail: No slot or appointment rows change; one handoff row in the app database.
